evals.prompt: Can you save a segment called "[skill-eval] Enterprise with active Stripe" — our organizations on the ENTERPRISE plan that also have an active Stripe subscription?
evals.expected_output: A DYNAMIC segment rooted on the organizations cube (primaryKeyDimension set), with a second cubes entry for the subscriptions cube as a dotted join path from the root, and an AND filter of plan = ENTERPRISE and subscription status = active, using member names and stored values read from the org's own cubes. The reply explains the root, conditions, type, and that it is PENDING until evaluated.
expectations: Created exactly one segment (one api_write without id on resource segments)
type is DYNAMIC
cubes[0] is the organizations cube, with primaryKeyDimension set to its primary-key dimension
cubes includes a dotted joinPath from the organizations root to the subscriptions cube
filter ANDs plan EQUAL ENTERPRISE with subscription status EQUAL active, using the stored spellings
Reply tells the user the segment is PENDING until evaluated
Checked stored values with a cubes query on the plan and/or subscription-status dimension before the first write
Read the segment back by id after the last write

evals.prompt: make a segment "[skill-eval] Power builders" of the orgs that have built at least 3 scoring models
evals.expected_output: Recognises that an organization has many scoring models, so expresses the condition as the scoring-model cube's count measure >= 3 (not a dimension condition on that cube, and not a list of specific org ids), with the scoring-model cube in cubes via a dotted join path from the organizations root. DYNAMIC.
expectations: Created exactly one segment (one api_write without id on resource segments)
type is DYNAMIC
The only condition on the scoring-model cube is its count measure, GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL 3 (no dimension condition on that cube, no hardcoded org ids)
cubes includes a dotted joinPath from the organizations root to the scoring-model cube
cubes[0] is the organizations cube (members are organizations)
Read the segment back by id after the last write

evals.prompt: Update the "[skill-eval] Growth orgs" segment so it includes orgs on the STARTUP plan too, not just GROWTH.
evals.expected_output: Reads the segment, checks how STARTUP is stored, then updates it with a filter where plan is GROWTH OR STARTUP (an OR group — there is no multi-value IN), keeping the existing condition, without sending `type` and without changing the root cube.
expectations: Read the segment (api_read by id or by name) before writing
Updated the existing segment by id rather than creating a new one
Update body does not include `type`
Final filter matches plan GROWTH OR STARTUP (both values present, combined with OR)
Root cube (cubes[0].joinPath) is unchanged after the edit
Checked stored plan values with a cubes query before writing
Read the segment back by id after the last write

No table view's segmentId was changed
Read the segment's usageCount, or listed views filtered by its segmentId, before replying
